lead: Worcester is known for its triple-deckers and its hills, and it gets real New England winters. Ice dams, frozen pipes and old multi-family plumbing cause most of its water damage.
risk: ice dams, frozen pipes and old multi-family plumbing
risk_short: ice dams, frozen pipes, old pipes
why: Worcester has thousands of triple-deckers, three-story wood homes with one unit on each floor. About 41% of homes were built before 1940. Many have porches stacked on the back, and the pipes that run to those porches and kitchens freeze in hard cold. When a pipe bursts on the top floor, water runs down through two more units. Old cast-iron drains and steam heat add more risk.

Worcester sits high in central Massachusetts and gets more snow than Boston. In the winter of 2015, a run of blizzards buried the city under one of its snowiest seasons on record. Snow sat on roofs for weeks, and ice dams sent meltwater into walls and ceilings across town. Spring melt and heavy rain also push water into old stone basements on the city's many hills.
image_alt: White two-story house with a snow-covered roof
image_caption: Heavy snow and ice dams send meltwater into Worcester walls and ceilings.
problems: Triple-deckers in Grafton Hill, Vernon Hill
Multi-family homes in Main South, Green Island
Stone basements on the city's hills
tips: Add attic insulation and air sealing to stop ice dams.
Insulate pipes that run to back porches and kitchens.
Rake snow off the lower roof edge after big storms.
Owners: know where each unit's water shutoff is.
areas: Calls come from Main South, Shrewsbury Street, Tatnuck, Burncoat, Grafton Hill, Vernon Hill, Indian Lake and Green Island, plus Shrewsbury, Auburn and Holden.

faq.q: Who pays for ice dam damage in a Worcester triple-decker?
faq.a: Most home and landlord policies cover sudden water damage from ice dams inside the walls and ceilings. They usually do not pay to remove the ice itself or fix the roof wear that caused it. Each tenant's renter's policy covers their own belongings. Take photos and report it fast.
